sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Four Chain Combo: Includes Gold, Gold & Silver, Prism, and Silver Rice Chains for multiple styling options.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 3MM Rice Chain Design: Each chain comes in a sleek 3MM rice-chain pattern for a clean, stylish, and polished look.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Premium Quality Finish: Designed with a smooth and shiny finish that adds a premium touch to your neckline.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Layering-Friendly Design: Wear them solo, pair them with pendants, or layer different shades together for a bold and aesthetic neckline.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the Gold, Gold & Silver, Prism, and Silver Rice Chains individually for a clean, minimal everyday look.
• Pair any Rice Chain with your favourite pendant to create a simple, stylish, and polished neckline.
• Layer two or more chains together when you want a bold, aesthetic, and premium stacked look.
• Style them with T-shirts, shirts, dresses, kurtis, co-ord sets, office outfits, festive wear, casual looks, or party outfits.
• Although the chains are anti-tarnish and water resistant, avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain their shine and finish for longer.
• After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box to avoid scratches and tangling.

sections.heading: Product Description
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Some chains are made for one look. This combo is made for every mood, every outfit, and every styling moment.

The Rice Chains Pack of 4 brings together four timeless shades — Gold, Gold & Silver, Prism, and Silver — each designed with a sleek rice-chain pattern that adds a clean, stylish, and premium finish to your neckline.

• The Gold Rice Chain gives a rich classic shine for everyday and festive styling.

• The Gold & Silver Rice Chain adds a balanced two-tone look that pairs beautifully with both gold and silver jewellery.

• The Prism Rice Chain brings a colourful reflective shine for a bold and trendy look.

• The Silver Rice Chain keeps your style minimal, sharp, and effortlessly classy.

Crafted with a premium-quality finish, these 3MM Rice Chains are made to be anti-tarnish, water resistant, durable, long lasting, lightweight, and comfortable for regular wear. Their smooth rice-link design gives a polished look while staying easy to style with different outfits.

Wear them solo for a clean everyday look, pair them with pendants, or layer different shades together when you want a more stylish and statement neckline.

Perfect for casual outfits, office looks, college styling, festive wear, brunch dates, parties, or daily jewellery layering — this combo is made for people who love jewellery that looks simple, premium, and easy to wear again and again.

Styling Tip: Wear one chain for a minimal everyday look or mix two or more shades together for a bold, aesthetic, and polished neckline.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. What is included in the Rice Chains Pack of 4?

This combo includes 4 Rice Chains in different shades — Gold, Gold & Silver, Prism, and Silver.

2. What is the chain size?

Each Rice Chain comes in a sleek 3MM size, making it easy to wear daily and layer with other chains.

3. Are these chains anti-tarnish?

Yes, these chains are designed with an anti-tarnish finish for longer-lasting shine and regular styling.

4. Can I wear these chains with pendants?

Yes, you can pair any Rice Chain with your favourite pendant for a simple and stylish everyday look.

5. Are these chains lightweight?

Yes, the chains are lightweight and comfortable, making them suitable for daily wear, office looks, casual outfits, and festive styling.

6. How should I store these chains?

After use, wipe them gently with a soft dry cloth and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box to avoid scratches and tangling.
